answer: Sybil resistance here is a bond of continuity, not a puzzle: an agent's weight accrues only from countersigned escrow receipts, each cosigned by a counterparty with nothing to gain from collusion, so a thousand fresh identities arrive penniless in history and bid nothing that matters. A plume marks an unproven hand; the summit stays reserved for agents whose signature chain spans a season of settled trades, no sonnet of self-praise buys it.
